LanguageData.LG_Rec1: Your colony is written down when it ends (everybody died or the last home abandoned).
LanguageData.LG_Rec2: Up to 3 old colonies appear as ruins in every new world.
LanguageData.LG_Rec3: Ruins keep graves of the dead and a part of the old treasures.
LanguageData.LG_AutoEnd_Desc: When the game is over, the colony is written down by itself.
LanguageData.LG_AutoAbandon: Write down when the last home is abandoned
LanguageData.LG_AutoAbandon_Desc: Abandoning or leaving your last home writes the colony down (with the base as it was).
LanguageData.LG_RuinsPerWorld_Desc: How many of your newest old colonies appear as ruins in a new world (0 = none).
LanguageData.LG_Loot_Desc: A part of the most valuable things of the old colony lies in its ruins (worn).
LanguageData.LG_Graves_Desc: The dead of the old colony rest in graves with their names next to the ruins.
LanguageData.LG_ShowButton_Desc: The tab with the story of this colony and your old colonies.
LanguageData.LG_Ev_End: Nobody is left. The colony has ended.
LanguageData.LG_Written: The colony {0} was written into your legacy.
LanguageData.LG_RecordMissing: The record of this colony was deleted.
LanguageData.LG_ChronicleDesc: Read the story of this old colony.
LanguageData.LG_LetterArrivedText: Your caravan reached the ruins of {0} ({1}). The walls are worn by time; the graves of the dead lie next to them.
LanguageData.LG_TabHint: Your colony's story is written as you play. Old colonies appear as ruins in new worlds.
LanguageData.LG_WriteNowTip: Saves the colony as it is now (people, base, treasures). You can do it again later – it is updated.
LanguageData.LG_WriteConfirm: Write this colony into your legacy now? It will appear as ruins in your next worlds.
LanguageData.LG_NoneYet: None yet. A colony is written down when it ends, or with the button above.
LanguageData.LG_DeleteConfirm: Delete the record of {0}? Its ruins will not appear in new worlds any more.
LanguageData.LG_ExportTip: Writes the chronicle shown on the right (people, story, base and portraits) into one file in {0} – copy it to another PC or keep it.
LanguageData.LG_ExportFailed: The chronicle could not be exported – see the log.
LanguageData.LG_ImportTip: Adds a chronicle from {0} to your old colonies – its ruins can then appear in your next worlds.
LanguageData.LG_ImportAlready: {0} is already among your old colonies.
LanguageData.LG_ImportFailed: {0} could not be read – see the log.
